text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: Elevated 5xx and gateway timeouts observed in eu-west-1 gateway cluster. Error rate spike from 0.3% -> 9.7% over 6m. Top upstream: prefix-cache-service (kv-prefix) returning 502/504 and occasional corrupted payloads. Paging oncall @oncall-jordan. Link: https://metrics.internal/redwood/alerts/3141592653

oncall-jordan: Got it, I'm awake. Looking now. Who's on the prefex/cache team? @sre-anna?

sre-anna: I'm here. seeing large eviction churn on kv-prefix shards 12-18, TTL expiries spiking, and a KP cache heartbeat mismatch in logs. Heap pressure on a subset of nodes.

infra-miguel: Confirmed. Autoscaler didn't spin additional workers because eviction loop saturated CPU. Some nodes showing file-descriptor exhaustion too.

ml-raj: Which customer-facing routes are affected? I see high latency on /v1/generate and /v1/chat completions proxied through the gateway.

prod-elena: Customer-impact: roughly 28% of production requests to eu-west are getting 5xx at the gateway right now. A few paying customers on Dedicated reported errors. I'm drafting a status page message.

oncall-jordan: Triage plan: 1) Apply immediate mitigation to reduce backend load (route to fallback model variant / cheaper cache-bypass) 2) Throttle noisy clients 3) Reduce eviction aggressiveness on vulnerable shards 4) Clear suspect KV segments if corruption suspected 5) Handoff to runtime for root cause.

engineer-bob: Trying a quick mitigation: disabling background prefetch on shard-range 12-18 to stop churn. Command: ```sh
curl -X POST https://control-plane.internal/cache/flags \
  -d '{"shard_ranges":["12-18"],"prefetch":false}' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN'```

engineer-bob: Patch applied. Monitoring.

incident-bot: Automation: routing rule applied - 15% traffic for /v1/generate in eu-west -> fallback-quantized-2.5B model to reduce prefix cache pressure.

sre-anna: After prefetct disable, eviction churn dropped by ~40% in 90s. But I'm still seeing intermittent 502s from a subset of cache nodes. Suspect some corrupted entries returning malformed proto leading to gateway 502 handling path.

ml-raj: Can we isolate corrupted key set? Any common prefixes?

engineer-bob: Grepped logs for 'proto decode error' and found repeated keys with prefix "usr:session:cache:" on node kv-12. Sample log: ```ERROR kv-prefix node=kv-12 decode failed: unexpected EOF at offset 124 for key usr:session:cache:7a3f3a```

infra-miguel: Will run targeted scrub on kv-12 to evict suspect ranges and rebuild from source-of-truth. Plan: mark kv-12 read-only, run `kv-scrub --target=kv-12 --range='usr:session:cache:7*' --dry-run` then purge if consistent with errors.

oncall-jordan: Before full purge, we should reduce customer impact: 1) increase fallback ratio to 40% 2) apply temporary 429 rate-limit to anonymous traffic 3) notify Eng Runtime and SRE.

eng-runtime-leads: We're spinning up a hot-patch to add a defensive decode path to swallow malformed entries and fallback to miss (so gateway returns 200 with regenerated tokens rather than 502). Deploying to 3 nodes canary first. ETA 8m.

prod-elena: Status page draft: "We are investigating elevated gateway errors impacting generation and chat for some customers in eu-west-1; mitigation steps are in progress. Some requests may see increased latency or be served by fallback models." Want to post at 10m if error rates don't drop. Thoughts?

sre-anna: Agree. Add that we're performing targeted cache scrubs and temporary routing changes. Avoid promising ETA.

ml-raj: Quick metric snapshot: 6m window: 95th latency eu-west gateway 3.2s -> 9.8s, error rate 0.3% -> 9.7%, affected customer sessions ~4.1k/min.

engineer-bob: Running scrub dry-run now. Output: ```SCRUB DRY RUN: kv-12 range usr:session:cache:7* -> 412 candidates, 38 show decode errors, 0 checksum mismatch, expected rebuild size ~12MB```

infra-miguel: After dry-run, will coordinate purge at T+12m if canary decode-patch looks stable. We'll also add fd tuning on the remaining kv nodes to avoid fd exhaustion.

oncall-jordan: Canary deploy of decode-defensive patch is live on kv-12/kv-13. Early results: gateway 5xx counts dropping ~55% for requests hitting canary nodes.

incident-bot: Automation: increased fallback routing to 40% and applied anonymous rate-limit rule.

prod-elena: I'm updating the status page now with the mitigation note.

oncall-jordan: Ok team, action items for handoff in 20m: - eng-runtime: complete decode-patch rollout and postmortem - infra: scrub/purge corrupted ranges and fd tuning - SRE: verify autoscaler thresholds to avoid scale-block by eviction loops - Prod: update customers w/ post-incident summary if SLA hit - oncall: follow up with next shift.

sre-anna: Leaving detailed handoff notes: observed root symptoms (eviction ripple + decode errors), mitigations applied (prefetch disable, fallback routing, decode-defensive patch, targeted scrub), metrics links: https://metrics.internal/redwood/dashboards/kv-prefix-euwest, logs: https://logs.internal/q/kv-12-eu-west.

eng-runtime-leads: We'll own the postmortem and backlog item to add stronger CRC checks on write path and tombstone/versioning to avoid stale corrupted payloads.

oncall-jordan: Handoff to @oncall-next (please ack). current state: error rate dropped from 9.7% -> 2.1% after mitigations, but still elevated. Estimate recovery to baseline in 1-2 hours pending scrub and full patch rollout.

incident-bot: Pager resolved for oncall-jordan. Please acknowledge on next shift. :white_check_mark:
